sections.text: My Story From editing videos to building business systems. I started with video editing, learning how pacing, captions, music, and B-roll keep people watching. Then I started working with AI content, product ads, and VSL-style videos, where every second needs to support attention and conversion. Today, I combine creative execution with technical systems: GoHighLevel, automation workflows, website/funnel design, content repurposing, and AI-assisted production. 01 / Foundation BSIT Graduate I started with a technical foundation: systems thinking, troubleshooting, web basics, and digital tools. That background helps me understand both creative work and the backend systems behind it. Technical Core 02 / Creative Execution Video Editor I moved into short-form edits, VSL-style videos, B-roll storytelling, captions, sound design, pacing, and retention-focused content built for TikTok, Reels, Shorts, and ads. Retention Editing 03 / AI Systems AI Content Creator I expanded into AI-generated visuals, character workflows, prompt engineering, voiceovers, product creatives, and fast content production using tools like Kling, Higgsfield, Flux, Gemini, and ElevenLabs. AI Workflow 04 / Business Systems Automation Builder Now I build digital systems: GoHighLevel setups, forms, calendars, funnels, lead capture, reporting trackers, and automation workflows that help businesses reduce manual work. GHL + Automation 05 / Current Direction CTO — Mary Digi Solutions Today, I combine video editing, AI content, websites, and automation as the technical lead for Mary Digi Solutions — helping turn ideas into systems, assets, and client-ready workflows. Digital Systems Creator
